usage: The word 藥房 (joek6 fong4) is used as a noun to refer to a place where medicine is sold or dispensed.
You can use 藥房 to talk about both small local pharmacies and larger drugstores.
It is commonly used to indicate the location when you need to buy or pick up medicine.
藥房 usually comes after location words in a sentence, like 去藥房 (go to the pharmacy).
You can combine 藥房 with verbs like 買 (buy), 去 (go), or 喺 (at) to form everyday sentences.
